title: A Billionaire investor just told me where he's putting his money right now
summary: This is episode 827 of the My First Million podcast, a ~1h45m conversation in which Shaan Puri interviews billionaire value investor Mohnish Pabrai about the mental models behind his investing. No transcript was available, so this summary is built from the title, description, and timestamped show notes only. The discussion covers Pabrai's core principles — introducing randomness, copying winning ideas, going an inch wide and a mile deep, avoiding Excel, waiting for 'fat pitches' — plus his 2026 stock picks, lessons from paying $650,000 to lunch with Warren Buffett, and the cautionary tale of investor Rick Guerin. The takeaway is a set of repeatable mental models for concentrated, patient value investing rather than any software or technical demonstration.
